question: Where does the enjoyer, having enjoyed, become Shiva at body-decay?
premises: desirous of enjoyment, where joined, having enjoyed that, at body-decay Shiva
but in mild-middle, there indeed in principle, somewhere appointed
inference: Enjoyment-joined decay ends in Shiva; mild-middle appoints somewhere in-principle.
plain_english: Desirous of enjoyment, where joined, having enjoyed that, at body-decay Shiva — but in mild-middle, there indeed in principle, somewhere appointed.
